features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public landing page with hero headline IF YOU'RE FIRED GET READY TO BE HIRED, CTAs for candidates and recruiters

features.name: Candidate Registration
features.description: Registration form for candidates with name, email, password validation. Redirects to onboarding after success.

features.name: Recruiter Registration
features.description: Registration form for recruiters with company name field.

features.name: Login
features.description: Login page with role tabs (Job Seeker / Recruiter), email and password fields, forgot password link.

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Two-step forgot password: enter email to get code, then enter code and new password.

features.name: Candidate Onboarding
features.description: 8-step wizard: basic info, work status (laid off/switch/other), employment, skills, resume upload, education, preferences, headline.

features.name: Candidate Dashboard
features.description: Shows verification status banner, resume upload, AI insights, recommended jobs.

features.name: Candidate Jobs
features.description: Browse jobs. Apply button shows lock icon if candidate not verified.

features.name: Candidate Schedule
features.description: Time slot picker for scheduling interview after recruiter invite. Shows confirmation on booking.

features.name: Interview Room
features.description: AI voice interview room with camera, push-to-talk mic, transcript panel, phase indicator.

features.name: Verification Room
features.description: Reuses interview room for one-time verification interview.

features.name: Candidate Scorecard
features.description: Shows AI assessment results after interview with score rings, dimension bars, feedback.

features.name: Recruiter Layout
features.description: White sidebar with blue active states, topbar with search, notification bell, Post Job button.

features.name: Recruiter Dashboard
features.description: Stats cards, recent applications table, upcoming interviews panel.

features.name: Recruiter Jobs
features.description: List of posted jobs with application counts. Create new job with AI-generated description.

features.name: Recruiter Candidates
features.description: Table of all applicants with verification score, status badges, Invite button.

features.name: Recruiter Assessments
features.description: List of AI assessments with verdict chips, score, integrity score.

features.name: Recruiter Analytics
features.description: KPI cards, hiring pipeline funnel, weekly activity chart.

features.name: Notification Bell
features.description: Bell icon with unread count badge, dropdown with notifications, mark read.

features.name: Auth API
features.description: Register, login, logout, forgot password, confirm password endpoints using Cognito + RDS.

features.name: Interview Chat API
features.description: Groq Whisper STT + LLaMA AI interviewer + session management endpoints.

features.name: Verification API
features.description: Start, status, retake, badge endpoints for candidate verification flow.

features.name: Jobs API
features.description: CRUD for job postings with JD embedding generation.

features.name: Applications API
features.description: Apply, list, invite endpoints. Returns verification score per applicant.

features.name: Notifications API
features.description: List, unread count, mark read endpoints.
